usedFor: Coursebox LMS enrolls people with “Invite and Enroll User to a Course” and “Enrol User into Group”.

bestTemplate.name: “Invite and Enroll User to a Course” in Coursebox LMS
bestTemplate.why: It invites a user and enrolls them in a selected course, so a sign-up gets a seat.

watchOut: “Unenrol User from Group” removes a user from a selected group, so check the user first.
